title: Adams Warehouse & Delivery, Inc.
description:
Adams Warehouse & Delivery, Inc. — a family-owned freight and logistics company operating 11 warehouse facilities in the Houston metro area since 1976.

The dataset includes complete server backup mirrors from multiple drives (D:, E:, Data, Network Shares), capturing the company's entire digital footprint:

Sage/Peachtree accounting system for 8 entities spanning FY2007–FY2025+, containing payroll, AR, AP, general ledger, and W-2 filing histories
52–72 Social Security Numbers with full identity packages (name, DOB, address, phone, emergency contacts, health insurance IDs) across 4 entities
Domain administrator passwords saved in 4 RDP files, plus plaintext VPN credentials, WiFi passwords, and 18 database connections with blank passwords
WDS source code — the company's custom warehouse distribution management system (VB6/.NET, multiple versions)
20+ years of customer data — rate cards, operations logs, and contact lists for 100+ warehouse customers including Honeywell, Hospira, Amway, and Kaiser
Medical clinic employee data — South Main Medical Clinic's bookkeeping within the Sage system, including physician SSN
11 Outlook PST email archives (largest: 1.5 GB)
